# sex assigned at birth

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:sexAssignedAtBirth`](gmeow-sexAssignedAtBirth.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/sexAssignedAtBirth>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gender`](../../slices/gender.md)

The sex recorded for a person at birth (a [`gmeow:SexAssignedAtBirth`](../classes/gmeow-SexAssignedAtBirth.md) value) — a RECORDED administrative datum, NOT a self-asserted identity and NOT a gufo [`IdentityFacet`](../classes/gmeow-IdentityFacet.md). Deliberately separate from gender identity/expression, which it never implies and is never implied by. Non-functional: a correction and a prior record coexist rather than contradict.
